_what: What tool:check-a-site-build-in-a-browser measures and when it refuses a page. viewport is the browser window every page is opened in. navigation_timeout_ms is how long a page may take to fire its load event (waitUntil load, never network idle: streaming media keeps the network busy for ever). settle_ms is how long scripts are given to draw after load. min_height_to_live is the share of the live page's height below which a built page is refused (a blank page). reading_selector names the element whose computed font-family is the reading font (the first match on the page; body is not used: some sites compute a serif body even when the page draws correctly). serif_pattern is a regular expression a font-family list matches when its first family is a serif default. check_query is the query a page view carries so the live site can tell this traffic apart; data calls (paths under data_call_prefix) are passed to the live site with no query added and with their Referer and Origin rewritten to the live host. words.server_rendered is said for a kind under a --server-rendered prefix. max_screenshot_px caps the height of a kept picture. pictures_folder is where the pictures go when the caller names no folder: the folder named by the environment variable `under` when it is set, else `else` ('~' is the home folder), then `folder`; a folder per commit is made inside it, so a gate's evidence outlives the run. summary_line_chars caps each line of the refusal summary that ends the output, so the last few hundred characters a workflow keeps name every refused kind. candidate_error_header marks the 502 the candidate door answers when the candidate cannot be reached. words holds the sentences a refusal says, each with its {fields}. Each value is a row a person changes, never code. parts names each kind of part a person sees (a CSS selector, and ready: loaded for a picture that drew, playable for a video that can play, any); min_parts_to_live is the share of the live page's count of a kind below which a built page is refused, for each kind the live page shows at least min_live_parts of.

words.short: the built page is {height_px} px tall, {height_to_live} of the live page's {live_height_px} px (refused under {min_height_to_live})
words.errors: the built page threw {count} error(s) the live page did not: {errors}
words.serif: the reading text is {font} on the build and {live_font} on the live page
words.absolute_errors: no live page exists and the built page threw: {errors}
words.absolute_blank: no live page exists and the built page shows no text
words.no_file: the build holds no file for this path
words.live_unreadable: the live page could not be read: {error}
words.server_rendered: the caller named this kind as drawn by the commit's server code, which a built folder cannot show; it is not checked here and must be checked on the running commit
words.candidate_unreadable: the candidate could not be read: {error}
words.answer_differs: it first answers {here} here and {there} on the live site
words.landing_differs: the browser ends at {here} here and at {there} on the live site
words.blank: the built page shows no text and the live page shows {live_text} characters
words.summary_blank: no text where live has text
words.fewer_parts: it shows {count} {part} where the live page shows {live_count} (refused under {min_parts_to_live} of live's)
